name: Restless Nights: The New Survival Loop

pages.text: Sleep Debt is no longer an automatic timer with penalties. Long-term debt rises while awake, physical fatigue rises from actual work, and stress rises from darkness, danger and combat. You are expected to prepare for nights.
Caffeine briefly masks symptoms but creates tolerance and crash risk. Herbal drinks calm stress and fatigue, but cannot substitute for true sleep.
A field bedroll now starts a seven-second rest. Stay nearby without moving or taking damage. The session can be interrupted; protected shelters, warmth and low stress improve recovery.
Use a Sleep Journal for a proper report on the last sleep quality, recovery and what disturbed your rest. No third-party UI library is needed.
